pages.text: The $(item)Fire Truck$() has a $(l)water tank$(), a $(l)hose$() and an $(l)aerial ladder$(). Hold right-click with a $(item)Fire Hose$() within 16 blocks of it to spray water up to twenty blocks: it puts out fire, campfires and burning mobs.
Every fire put out pays the Firefighter job.

Fill the tank at a $(item)Fire Hydrant$() (park within 6 blocks), from open water beside the truck, or by the bucket.$(br2)Park and press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch): the ladder swings up behind the truck, up to 16 blocks. Climb it like scaffolding.
The ladder runs up a wall when the truck backs up to a building.
